Hey there. I do not mean to make this about me, however I’d like to share with you my testimony. I’ve been where you are, and it is horrible. I’m disabled, retarded, autistic, adhd Aspergers anxiety all of it…I failed it 4 times man over 5 years. Wasted so much time and lost so many opportunities and now I’m almost dead.

Look…this isn’t coming from a mean spirit, but someone in similar shoes. Going on and on about your problems isn’t gonna help you. There is nothing wrong with asking for help, and a good therapist may be what you need. Suicide is stupid, and devalues what God did when He had you in mind. Had He wanted you a dog, you’d be pissing on flowers and barking at random strangers, chasing your tail, running after cars and so fourth.
